# 1. When no sources/skills exist, list warns
exec axen list
stdout 'No skills installed'

# 2. Setup mock source repository
mkdir mock-source/skill1
mkdir mock-source/skill2

-- mock-source/skill1/SKILL.md --
---
name: skill1
description: Skill 1
---
# Skill 1

-- mock-source/skill2/SKILL.md --
---
name: skill2
description: Skill 2
---
# Skill 2

-- mock-source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "mock-source",
  "skills": {
    "skill1": { "path": "skill1" },
    "skill2": { "path": "skill2" }
  }
}

# 3. Add source and install skills
exec axen source add ./mock-source -n my-skills --install
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill1/SKILL.md
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.claude/skills/skill2/SKILL.md

# 4. Assert list output shows installed skills and totals
exec axen list
stdout 'my-skills'
stdout 'skill1'
stdout 'skill2'
stdout '2 skill\(s\) installed across 1 source\(s\)'
